_comment: The venues package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/commerce_PRD.md §4.11, D8). They name only its own
types and only @authenticated: no slot, so no application has to bind anything.
Venues are a shared catalogue: every signed-in user lists them and proposes new ones or changes; each save is an
Approvals document proposal (modifications always, creations when ApproveCreations is on). Layouts are created and
copied by the package's endpoints (New is not granted); only their name is a form field, renamed by the owner as a
proposal, and VenueLayoutActions' row rule hides other users' drafts.
The application grants the approvers: { "resource": "ApproveProposal/Venue", "groupId": "…" } and
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "ticketing-venues": false }.
